candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502 with ~2s latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory, ReadTimeout on order, and 502 on gateway /v1/checkout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2406ms matching the ~2s timeouts. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying Redis cause unproven.
